question.text: The underlying for MIBOR futures is:

answer.text: Daily FBIL Overnight MIBOR (Mumbai Interbank Outright Rate) for the contract month

explanation.text: The Logic: MIBOR futures are based on the Daily FBIL Overnight MIBOR for the contract month. Final settlement uses the simple average of daily FBIL overnight MIBOR rates over the contract month. The Trap: The 91-day T-Bill rate is the underlying for T-Bill futures; the RBI repo rate is a policy rate, not the futures underlying; the 10-year yield underlies GOI bond futures. Each IRF product has a distinct underlying. Note: FBIL is the publisher of the overnight MIBOR benchmark used here; no additional cross-market or use-case claims should be read into this answer beyond what the workbook states.
